# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games centered on placing numbers according to numeric rules*
- Ripple Effect
- Sudoku
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin

## 3. Path & Loop Games
*Games focused on drawing continuous paths, loops, or connections*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hashiwokakero
- Dotchi-Loop
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Hebi
- Pencils

## 4. Shading & Painting Games
*Games requiring cells to be shaded or colored according to rules*
- Nurikabe
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Heyawake
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Norinori
- LITS
- Usowan
- Akari

## 5. Shape & Piece Placement Games
*Games involving placing defined shapes or blocks onto the grid*
- Chained Block
- Sto-stone
- Shakashaka

## 6. Movement & Sliding Games
*Games involving moving or directing elements across the grid*
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri
- Sashigane
- Kurotto

## 7. Arrow & Direction Games
*Games governed by directional clues or orientation rules*
- Yajilin
- Nurimisaki
- Ripple Effect *(moved to #1)*
- Mid-loop *(moved to #3)*

---

> **Final corrected Category 7:**
- Yajilin
- Nurimisaki
